security.access_control: ISA allowance data restricted to authenticated customer session

security.audit: ISA declaration timestamp and text recorded immutably

security.access_control: Account creation restricted to authenticated system process
Customer authenticated; SCA not required for internal account-to-account transfer below threshold

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: ISA Allowance Integrity
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: IsaSubscriptionRecord.subscription_used must never exceed 20,000 in a single tax year. Concurrent deposit attempts must be handled with optimistic locking to prevent ISA over-subscription.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: ISA over-subscription is a tax compliance breach — HMRC can void the ISA and the customer loses the tax benefit. Atomic updates required.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Account Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: SavingsAccount and IsaSubscriptionRecord retained for minimum 6 years after account closure (HMRC requirement for ISA records).
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: HMRC can audit ISA records up to 6 years after the tax year in question.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: FSCS Disclosure
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: FSCS protection information must be prominently displayed at account opening and in the confirmation notification. Cannot be hidden in terms and conditions.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: PRA Depositor Protection Rules and BCOBS require prominent FSCS disclosure.

regulatory_slas.name: ISA Annual Allowance Enforcement
regulatory_slas.requirement: Total Cash ISA subscriptions per customer per tax year must not exceed £20,000
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: ISA voided by HMRC; customer loses tax benefit; bank liable for incorrect ISA management

regulatory_slas.name: HMRC Annual ISA Return
regulatory_slas.requirement: Annual ISA return submitted to HMRC by 5 October following the end of the tax year
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: HMRC fine; potential loss of ISA account manager status

regulatory_slas.name: FSCS Protection Communication
regulatory_slas.requirement: FSCS protection status must be disclosed at account opening and on statement
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA supervisory action; Consumer Duty breach
